# snazzieR

Chic and sleek functions for beautiful statisticians.

snazzieR formats regression output for R Markdown reports. Its tables
come out as LaTeX for PDF documents or as plain text for the console,
and its plots share one ggplot2 theme and a palette of 35 named colors.

## Installation

``` r

# Released version, from CRAN
install.packages("snazzieR")

# Development version, from GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("DetectiveFierce/snazzieR")
```

## Functions

| Task | Functions |
|----|----|
| Summarize a linear model | [`model.summary.table()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/model.summary.table.md), [`ANOVA.summary.table()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/ANOVA.summary.table.md), [`model.equation()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/model.equation.md) |
| Check a fitted model | [`diagnostics.plots()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/diagnostics.plots.md), [`marginal.model.plots()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/marginal.model.plots.md), [`unusual.points.table()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/unusual.points.table.md), [`VIF.table()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/VIF.table.md) |
| Partial least squares | [`pls.regression()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/pls.regression.md), [`SVD.pls()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/SVD.pls.md), [`NIPALS.pls()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/NIPALS.pls.md), [`pls.summary()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/pls.summary.md) |
| Ridge regression | [`ridge.regression()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/ridge.regression.md), [`ridge.summary()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/ridge.summary.md) |
| Eigenvalues of a correlation or covariance matrix | [`eigen.summary()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/eigen.summary.md) |
| Plot styling | [`snazzieR.theme()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/snazzieR.theme.md), [`color.ref()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/color.ref.md), and colors such as `Red` and `Dark.Blue` |

## Example

``` r

library(snazzieR)

model <- lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)

# Coefficients, fit statistics and the fitted equation in one table.
# Returns LaTeX by default; latex = FALSE prints to the console.
model.summary.table(model, title = "Fuel Economy", latex = FALSE)

# The four plot(lm) panels as ggplots
diagnostics.plots(model)

# Observations worth a second look, labelled by car name
unusual.points.table(model, latex = FALSE, id = rownames(mtcars))

# Variance inflation factors
VIF.table(model, latex = FALSE)
```

![Residuals vs Fitted, Q-Q, Scale-Location and Residuals vs Leverage
panels drawn by
diagnostics.plots()](reference/figures/README-diagnostics.png)

## Table previews

A LaTeX table has nothing to show when you run a chunk with the “Run”
button, so snazzieR tables print an HTML preview in RStudio and Positron
and a plain-text preview in other interactive sessions. Knitting
produces the LaTeX. Set `options(snazzieR.preview = "html")`, `"text"`
or `"latex"` to pick one;
[`?snazzieR_table`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/snazzieR_table.md)
has the details.

# Package index

## PLS Functions

Functions for Partial Least Squares regression

- [`pls.regression()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/pls.regression.md)
  : Partial Least Squares (PLS) Regression Interface
- [`NIPALS.pls()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/NIPALS.pls.md)
  : Partial Least Squares Regression via NIPALS (Internal)
- [`SVD.pls()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/SVD.pls.md)
  : Partial Least Squares Regression via SVD (Internal)
- [`pls.summary()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/pls.summary.md)
  : Format PLS Model Output as LaTeX Tables

## Formatting Functions

Functions for formatting and displaying results

- [`model.summary.table()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/model.summary.table.md)
  : Generate a Summary Table for a Linear Model
- [`ANOVA.summary.table()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/ANOVA.summary.table.md)
  : Generate a Summary Table for ANOVA Results
- [`eigen.summary()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/eigen.summary.md)
  : Summarize Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors of a Covariance Matrix
- [`model.equation()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/model.equation.md)
  : Generate a Model Equation from a Linear Model
- [`format(`*`<pls>`*`)`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/format.pls.md)
  : Format PLS Model Output as LaTeX or Console Tables
- [`print(`*`<snazzieR_table>`*`)`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/snazzieR_table.md)
  [`knit_print(`*`<snazzieR_table>`*`)`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/snazzieR_table.md)
  : Interactive Previews for snazzieR Tables

## Regression Diagnostics

Diagnostic plots and tables of unusual observations

- [`diagnostics.plots()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/diagnostics.plots.md)
  [`print(`*`<snazzieR_plot_grid>`*`)`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/diagnostics.plots.md)
  : Snazzy Regression Diagnostic Plots
- [`marginal.model.plots()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/marginal.model.plots.md)
  : Snazzy Marginal Model Plots
- [`unusual.points.table()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/unusual.points.table.md)
  : Table of Unusual Observations in a Regression
- [`VIF.table()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/VIF.table.md)
  : Variance Inflation Factor Table

## Ridge Regression

Functions for ridge models

- [`create_kfold_splits()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/create_kfold_splits.md)
  : Create K-Fold Cross Validation Splits
- [`kfold_cross_validation()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/kfold_cross_validation.md)
  : Perform K-Fold Cross Validation
- [`predict(`*`<ridge.model>`*`)`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/predict.ridge.model.md)
  : Predict Method for Ridge Model Objects
- [`print(`*`<ridge.model>`*`)`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/print.ridge.model.md)
  : Print Method for Ridge Model Objects
- [`ridge.regression()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/ridge.regression.md)
  : Ridge Regression with Automatic Lambda Selection
- [`ridge.summary()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/ridge.summary.md)
  : Format Ridge Model Output as LaTeX Tables

## Theme Functions

Functions for customizing the appearance

- [`snazzieR.theme()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/snazzieR.theme.md)
  : A Custom ggplot2 Theme for Publication-Ready Plots
- [`color.list`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/colors.md)
  : SnazzieR Color Palette
- [`color.ref()`](https://detectivefierce.github.io/snazzieR/reference/color.ref.md)
  : Display a Color Reference Palette
